title: Zesty Nutty American Oat Bake
description: A nutty, aerated, and romantic American dish featuring ground oats, perfect for a special breakfast or brunch, this high-protein friendly recipe is made in a Dutch oven.

ingredients.name: ground oats
ingredients.notes: old-fashioned or rolled oats work well

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the ground oats, chopped almonds, dried cranberries, and brown sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla extract, and salt.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Pour the mixture into a greased Dutch oven.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm, topped with additional chopped nuts and dried fruit if desired.
